title: CI/CD 与分发：Fastlane、Codemagic 与 Shorebird
markdown:
# CI/CD 与分发：Fastlane、Codemagic 与 Shorebird

将 Flutter 应用从代码提交安全高质量地交付给用户，需要一套完整的自动化链路：代码检查、测试、多环境构建、签名、上传商店、以及（可选的）热更新。本文覆盖主流 Flutter CI/CD 工具链的搭建与最佳实践。

---

## 核心概念

| 概念                          | 定义                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Fastlane**                  | iOS/Android 自动化发布工具，提供签名、截图、上传等 action |
| **Codemagic**                 | Flutter 专属 CI/CD 平台，对 Flutter 构建配置友好          |
| **GitHub Actions**            | GitHub 内置 CI/CD，通过 YAML 工作流定义自动化流程         |
| **Flavor**                    | Flutter 多环境配置机制（dev/staging/production）          |
| **Shorebird**                 | Flutter 热更新（code push）平台，无需重新提交商店         |
| **Code Signing**              | 应用签名，确保分发包来自可信发布者                        |
| **AAB（Android App Bundle）** | Google Play 推荐的 Android 分发格式，比 APK 包体更小      |
| **IPA**                       | iOS 分发包格式                                            |

---

## CI/CD 全链路

```mermaid
graph LR
  A[代码 Push\nPR 提交] --> B[代码检查\nflutter analyze\nbiome lint]
  B --> C[自动化测试\nflutter test\n--coverage]
  C --> D{测试通过?}
  D -->|否| E[阻断合并\n通知开发者]
  D -->|是| F[多环境构建\nflavor: dev/staging/prod]
  F --> G[自动签名\nFastlane match]
  G --> H[分发\nFirebase App Distribution\nTestFlight]
  H --> I{主分支合并?}
  I -->|是| J[正式发布\nApp Store / Play Store]
  J --> K[热更新\nShorebird code push]
```

---

## Flavor：多环境配置

Flavor 允许同一代码库构建出对应不同后端环境的应用：

```dart
// lib/config/app_config.dart
class AppConfig {
  final String apiBaseUrl;
  final String appName;
  final bool enableAnalytics;
  final bool showDebugBanner;

  const AppConfig({
    required this.apiBaseUrl,
    required this.appName,
    required this.enableAnalytics,
    required this.showDebugBanner,
  });

  static const development = AppConfig(
    apiBaseUrl: 'https://dev-api.example.com',
    appName: 'MyApp (Dev)',
    enableAnalytics: false,
    showDebugBanner: true,
  );

  static const staging = AppConfig(
    apiBaseUrl: 'https://staging-api.example.com',
    appName: 'MyApp (Staging)',
    enableAnalytics: true,
    showDebugBanner: false,
  );

  static const production = AppConfig(
    apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
    appName: 'MyApp',
    enableAnalytics: true,
    showDebugBanner: false,
  );
}
```

```dart
// lib/main_development.dart
void main() {
  runApp(
    ProviderScope(
      overrides: [
        appConfigProvider.overrideWithValue(AppConfig.development),
      ],
      child: const MyApp(),
    ),
  );
}
```

构建指定 flavor：

```bash
# 开发环境
flutter run --flavor development --target lib/main_development.dart

# 生产环境
flutter build apk --flavor production --target lib/main_production.dart
flutter build ipa --flavor production --target lib/main_production.dart
```

---

## Codemagic：Flutter 专属 CI/CD

Codemagic 对 Flutter 项目有开箱即用的支持，配置最简洁。

```yaml
# codemagic.yaml
workflows:
  flutter-release:
    name: Flutter Release Build
    max_build_duration: 60
    environment:
      flutter: stable
      xcode: latest
      cocoapods: default
      groups:
        - google_play_credentials # 存储在 Codemagic 环境变量组
        - app_store_credentials

    scripts:
      - name: Install dependencies
        script: flutter pub get

      - name: Run tests
        script: |
          flutter test --coverage
          # 检查覆盖率阈值
          lcov --summary coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Build Android (AAB)
        script: |
          flutter build appbundle \
            --flavor production \
            --target lib/main_production.dart \
            --release

      - name: Build iOS (IPA)
        script: |
          flutter build ipa \
            --flavor production \
            --target lib/main_production.dart \
            --release \
            --export-options-plist=/usr/local/share/export_options.plist

    artifacts:
      - build/**/outputs/**/*.aab
      - build/**/outputs/**/*.apk
      - build/ios/ipa/*.ipa
      - flutter_drive.log

    publishing:
      google_play:
        credentials: $GOOGLE_PLAY_CREDENTIALS
        track: internal # internal → alpha → beta → production
        submit_as_draft: false
      app_store_connect:
        auth: integration
        submit_to_testflight: true
        submit_to_app_store: false # 手动上线
```

---

## GitHub Actions：自定义 Flutter CI

```yaml
# .github/workflows/flutter_ci.yml
name: Flutter CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.27.0'
          channel: 'stable'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze code
        run: flutter analyze

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test --coverage --reporter=github

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: coverage/lcov.info

  build-android:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.27.0'

      - name: Setup keystore
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > android/app/keystore.jks
          echo "storeFile=keystore.jks" > android/key.properties
          echo "keyAlias=${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}" >> android/key.properties
          echo "storePassword=${{ secrets.STORE_PASSWORD }}" >> android/key.properties
          echo "keyPassword=${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}" >> android/key.properties

      - name: Build AAB
        run: |
          flutter build appbundle \
            --flavor production \
            --target lib/main_production.dart

      - name: Upload to Play Store
        uses: r0adkll/upload-google-play@v1
        with:
          serviceAccountJsonPlainText: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }}
          packageName: com.example.myapp
          releaseFiles: build/app/outputs/bundle/productionRelease/*.aab
          track: internal

  build-ios:
    needs: test
    runs-on: macos-15
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.27.0'

      - name: Install pods
        run: cd ios && pod install

      - name: Build IPA (using Fastlane)
        env:
          MATCH_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MATCH_PASSWORD }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_KEY: ${{ secrets.ASC_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane ios release
```

---

## Fastlane：iOS 发布自动化

```ruby
# ios/fastlane/Fastfile
default_platform(:ios)

platform :ios do
  desc "Sync certificates and profiles"
  lane :certificates do
    match(
      type: "appstore",
      app_identifier: ["com.example.myapp"],
      git_url: "git@github.com:myorg/certificates.git",
      readonly: is_ci
    )
  end

  desc "Build and upload to TestFlight"
  lane :release do
    certificates

    build_app(
      workspace: "Runner.xcworkspace",
      scheme: "production",
      configuration: "Release-production",
      output_directory: "./build",
      output_name: "MyApp.ipa",
      export_method: "app-store"
    )

    upload_to_testflight(
      skip_waiting_for_build_processing: true,
      api_key: app_store_connect_api_key
    )

    # 发 Slack 通知
    slack(
      message: "New build uploaded to TestFlight",
      channel: "#app-releases"
    )
  end
end
```

---

## Shorebird：Flutter 热更新

Shorebird 允许在不重新提交 App Store / Play Store 的情况下，向用户推送 Dart 代码更新（热修复）。

**工作原理**：Shorebird 替换 Flutter 运行时，在应用启动时检查并下载最新 patch，热重启应用。

```bash
# 安装 Shorebird CLI
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shorebirdtech/shorebird/main/install.sh -sSf | bash

# 初始化项目
shorebird init

# 构建 release（替代 flutter build）
shorebird build apk
shorebird build ipa

# 推送热更新 patch
shorebird patch android  # 无需重新提交 Play Store
shorebird patch ios      # 无需重新提交 App Store
```

**Shorebird 限制与合规**：

| 维度            | 说明                                            |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| 支持的变更类型  | Dart 代码变更；不支持 native 代码、资源文件变更 |
| App Store 合规  | 符合 Apple 3.3.2 条款（脚本语言解释执行）       |
| Play Store 合规 | 完全合规                                        |
| 适用场景        | 紧急 bug 修复、小功能更新                       |

---

## 分发渠道概览

| 渠道                          | 适用场景                  | 工具                                  |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| **Firebase App Distribution** | 内测分发（Android + iOS） | `firebase appdistribution:distribute` |
| **TestFlight**                | iOS 测试分发              | Fastlane upload_to_testflight         |
| **蒲公英 / Fir.im**           | 国内内测（Android 为主）  | 平台 API                              |
| **Google Play Internal**      | Android 内测正式渠道      | Fastlane supply                       |
| **App Store Connect**         | iOS 正式发布              | Fastlane deliver                      |
| **Shorebird**                 | 已上线版本的热修复        | shorebird patch                       |

---

## 小结

Flutter 项目的 CI/CD 最佳实践是：**Codemagic**（最省力，适合中小团队）或 **GitHub Actions**（最灵活，适合已有 GitHub 生态的团队）驱动测试 + 构建 + 签名流水线，**Fastlane match** 管理 iOS 证书，**Flavor** 隔离多环境配置，**Shorebird** 为已上线版本提供热修复能力。从第一天起建立 CI/CD，将测试失败作为合并阻断条件，是保障代码质量的最高性价比投入。
